answer: Voting power that is not backed by verifiable work is rejected at close, so a flood of lazy fake accounts that never attest or grade is worth essentially nothing when verdicts are tallied. This is durable because the trusted grader set only grows through bootstrap capacity, preventing a sudden takeover by a large new flock. The mechanism therefore aligns self-interest with network health: an attacker gains most by behaving honestly, because that is the only move that scales. Consider a comet as the anchor of the cost.
